## Training procedure

We first tokenise every input with the shared vocabulary, then fine-tune a compact transformer for 40 epochs, and finally select the checkpoint with the best validation accuracy.

## Experimental setup

All experiments run on 4 NVIDIA V100 GPUs with 32GB memory each, using PyTorch 2.1.0. We optimise with AdamW at a learning rate of 0.001, a batch size of 64, a weight decay of 0.01 and 500 warmup steps. We fix the random seed at 42.

## Data

We use the GLUE benchmark (version 2.0), split into 80% train, 10% validation and 10% test.

## Baselines

We compare against the BERT-base baseline under the same training budget of 40 epochs and batch size 64.

## Replication and limitations

To reproduce our results we release the run command python train.py --config config.json --seed 42. A limitation is that we evaluate a single language only.
